title: Board Play Palette Drop Node Disappears
description: Fix board play drag-and-drop from palette: node briefly appears after drop then disappears on next interaction.
summary: Fixed palette drag-drop nodes vanishing on the next board interaction. Root cause: syncBoardScene purged objects via scene.remove(), which emitted nodeDelete; BoardStructuralDeleteReporter in board play treated those as authoritative and removed nodes from the shared fixture. BoardScene.withDescriptorSync now suppresses lifecycle delete events during declarative JSX sync. Added unit tests for purge-without-emit and palette-style resync retention. All 78 board unit tests and board-play e2e pass.
